grovefs-client prebuilt clients
built: 2026-11-22
host: Linux 5.4.0-216-generic x86_64
rustc: rustc 1.99.0 (b940084d7 2026-09-28)
cargo: cargo 1.99.0 (5f94df478 2026-08-27)
source: grovefs-client 68ce107 (source/docs commit; the two binaries,
        SHA256SUMS.txt and this file are the release artifacts in this drop)
        against sibling grovefs kernel at f435975 (master; manager-only mount
        and signed-roster resolution are the kernel tree used at build time,
        so these clients link exactly the tree that commit pins)
profile: release, lto=true, stripped
grovefs-mac: Linux build, fuser pure-Rust mount (macOS build needs macFUSE 4.x)
grovefs-win: Linux build, cfg(not(windows)) stub, no WinFsp FFI
what changed vs the previous drop (4534a6a @ kernel 963553c):
  * Mount bootstrap from a `grovefs manager`: --manager HOST:PORT resolves BOTH
    service coordinates from one signed roster, so an operator no longer hands
    out meta- and data addresses to every client machine. --roster-key-file is
    required (an unverified roster is an instruction to connect wherever someone
    else signed for). --meta-addr/--data-addr are no longer accepted at all;
    passing either is an unknown-argument error. GROVEFS_MANAGER /
    GROVEFS_DEPLOYMENT / GROVEFS_ROSTER_KEY_FILE work as env fallbacks, item for
    item with `grovefs mount`.
  * A roster declaring MORE THAN ONE data server is refused, not mounted against
    one member. Client-side striping lives in backend::sharded, which is
    `native`-gated, so a remote-only build cannot serve a striped deployment;
    picking a member would hand this mount a layout other than the one the
    deployment declared. The kernel `grovefs mount` of the SAME roster does
    mount — the kernel repo's client stage pins both halves of that asymmetry.
  * --meta-addr/--data-addr were removed from the client CLI. Coordinates now
    come only from the manager's signed roster; there is no direct-address
    fallback and every previous hand-typed command line must be migrated.
regression: `cargo test --workspace` from this source tree: grovefs-mac
        7 tests and grovefs-win 18 tests (11 mapping + 7 roster/bootstrap);
        the manager-only CLI contract rejects --meta-addr/--data-addr, resolves
        both coordinates from a signed roster, and refuses missing keys,
        incomplete rosters and striped data rosters. Release help and
        `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt` were also checked for this drop.
